description: This file defines the BackendApi facade, which encapsulates all backend REST API calls related to modules, exams, and health checks in the frontend web application. It includes method stubs for fetching health status, module list, exam configuration, exam questions, and submitting exam attempts, with some methods throwing 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED' errors.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a health check on the backend, returning a message.

methods.name: listModules
methods.description: Supposed to return a list of module summaries, but currently throws a 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED' error.

methods.name: getModuleExamConfig
methods.description: Returns default exam configuration for a given module ID; backend should eventually provide real data.

methods.name: getExamQuestions
methods.description: Intended to fetch exam questions for a module, but currently throws a 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED' error.

methods.name: submitExamAttempt
methods.description: Submits an exam attempt with user answers; currently throws a 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED' error.
